jobs.title: Senior Vice President, Enterprise Technology & Compliance
jobs.description:
About Kindsight:

Kindsight builds technology that helps fundraisers make a difference. For decades, Kindsight has supported the education, healthcare, and nonprofit sectors with fundraising tools and the largest charitable giving database on the market. And as the giving sector evolves, so does Kindsight. As the leader in fundraising intelligence, Kindsight leverages real-time data and AI to help thousands of organizations around the world identify, manage, and engage with donors - at any scale. With purpose-built CRMs that corral all of that donor information and campaign tracking into one place, donor prospect research tools that offer proactive insights and real-time donor intel, and generative AI that creates personalized, meaningful content drafts at scale, Kindsight’s product suite is truly changing the game for donor fundraising.

Position Summary:

We are seeking a strategic technology executive with extensive experience leading enterprise technology, cybersecurity, and compliance within a growing SaaS business. This leader will enable the business through modern, secure, and scalable technology while accelerating Kindsight's transformation into an AI-native company. Working closely with the CTO, you will lead the enterprise technology strategy that enables the business while complementing the company's product and engineering strategy. You will hire, lead, and develop a high-performing Enterprise Technology organization spanning IT, cybersecurity, and compliance. You will be responsible for ensuring budget discipline while optimizing technology investments and operating costs. In addition to enterprise technology responsibilities, this role will ensure the business operates within legal, regulatory, and ethical boundaries—especially around data, privacy, and global software regulations.

What You’ll Do:

AI Strategy

Lead the development and execution of Kindsight’s internal enterprise AI adoption strategy, partnering with executive leadership to improve productivity, automate business processes, and deliver measurable operational and financial outcomes. .
Translate strategy into a clear technology roadmap across infrastructure, systems, and enterprise applications, supporting an AI-native operating model and a scalable, cost-effective SaaS environment.
Lead enterprise technology transformation initiatives, including Lead-to-Cash, business systems modernization, business intelligence, and AI enablement, with accountability for execution, organizational adoption, and measurable business outcomes. .
Lead technology due diligence and integration for acquisitions, strategic partnerships, and other corporate initiatives.

IT Operations and Business Systems

Own Kindsight’s enterprise technology ecosystem: business systems (ERP, CRM, HRIS), infrastructure, networks, collaboration platforms, and enterprise data architecture.
Oversee day-to-day IT operations and end-user services, ensuring reliability, performance, and scalability, with strong service management practices including SLAs and incident management.

Security and Risk

Own Kindsight’s enterprise information security program, establishing and maintaining appropriate security policies, controls, monitoring, and risk mitigation practices across corporate technology environments.
Identify and manage technology risks, including vulnerabilities, third-party exposure, and operational risk.
Oversee incident response, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning.

Compliance and Privacy

Lead Kindsight’s information security and technology compliance programs, establishing governance, policies, controls, and audit readiness aligned with applicable regulatory requirements and recognized frameworks, including SOC 2 and ISO 27001.
Establish governance for AI usage, third-party technology risk, and enterprise data management.
Drive audit readiness, coordinate internal and external audits, and serve as the key contact for auditors, regulators, and enterprise customers.
Oversee data privacy practices and monitor regulatory developments affecting SaaS and CRM platforms.

Partnership and Culture

Partner with Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, Sales, and Customer Success to establish consistent security and compliance standards, support customer security assessments, and ensure appropriate governance across enterprise and customer-facing technology. Provide clear, concise updates to executive leadership on risk, security posture, and compliance status.

People and Budget

Hire, lead, and develop IT and compliance teams, including directors and managers, with clear accountability, performance expectations, and succession planning.
Manage the IT and compliance budget and oversee vendor selection, contracts, and performance, ensuring technology investments deliver business value.
Build a culture of security, compliance, and responsible data use, including employee training programs.

What We’re Looking For:

12+ years of progressive leadership experience in enterprise technology, cybersecurity, or IT operations, including significant executive-level responsibility within a complex SaaS or technology organization.
In-depth knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST), compliance standards (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.), and data protection.
Proven executive leadership of enterprise-wide business transformation initiatives, serving as the accountable executive responsible for strategy, governance, planning, execution, and organizational adoption.
Demonstrated experience developing and executing enterprise transformation roadmaps, including program governance, milestones, dependencies, and executive reporting.
Proven experience creating and leading enterprise-wide communication and change management strategies that keep employees, leaders, and stakeholders informed and aligned throughout transformational initiatives.
Track record of leading complex cross-functional initiatives across Technology, Product, Finance, Operations, Sales, and Customer Success while driving organizational alignment and measurable business outcomes.
Demonstrated experience managing enterprise technology budgets, optimizing vendor expenditures, and allocating resources to deliver measurable business value.
Deep understanding of enterprise architecture, cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), and scalable infrastructure management.
Strategic Vision: Ability to align technology roadmap with business objectives to enhance competitive advantage.
Demonstrated experience deploying AI technologies to improve productivity, automate business processes, and drive measurable business outcomes across enterprise functions.
Leadership: Exceptional team leadership, mentoring, and talent development skills, with experience managing remote or distributed teams.
Communication: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and the Board of Directors.
Vendor Management: Strong negotiation skills for managing relationships with strategic technology partners and vendors.
Experience leading enterprise technology within a high-growth SaaS organization, preferably in a private equity-backed environment.
Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or IT, Cybersecurity or Information Systems and MBA or equivalent is an asset.

What Success Looks Like

Accelerate responsible AI adoption across Kindsight's business functions, delivering measurable improvements in productivity and operational efficiency.
Maintain a secure, highly available enterprise technology environment.
Strengthen the company's security and compliance posture.
Optimize technology investments while improving employee productivity.
Build and develop a high-performing enterprise technology organization.

What’s in it for you?

Compensation Range: $300,000-$350,000 CAD/USD OTE annually, based on experience, market benchmarks and role complexity. We aim to offer fair, competitive pay that reflects your skills and the market.
Time to unplug: Vacation, flex days, volunteer time and a team-wide year-end wellness shutdown.
Whole-person health: Comprehensive health and dental, 24/7 virtual doctor visits and flexible wellness stipends.
Flexibility first: Digital-first remote setup with built-in “work from anywhere” travel flexibility.
Investment in you: Departmental professional development budgets and company-matched retirement savings.
A team that celebrates: Paid parental leave, peer recognition rewards and company-wide celebrations.

This advertised position is for an existing vacancy at Kindsight. At Kindsight, we’re proud to be a place where everyone belongs and has an equal opportunity to contribute, thrive and grow. We hire based on skills, potential, and impact, and we believe our differences fuel innovation. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. We’re building a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to do meaningful work and make a difference.

We leverage artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our people, not AI. Our intent is to use AI thoughtfully to streamline administrative tasks, improve the candidate experience and support fair, unbiased hiring practices consistent with industry standards .

jobs.title: VP Enterprise Marketing
jobs.description:
Mentimeter is an engagement company with a simple goal: to make every leader better. Through interaction, insights and recommendations, its platform helps organizations turn participation into better understanding and stronger performance.

Founded in Stockholm in 2012, Mentimeter is used by 20 million people each month across 1.3 million organizations. At Mentimeter, we believe better leadership starts with listening and that the strongest results are achieved together. That's why we foster a culture built on curiosity, collaboration and shared ownership. By joining us, you'll help leaders turn participation into deeper understanding and stronger performance, advancing our ambition to help more than one billion people listen, learn and work better together.

Build Mentimeter's enterprise growth engine

40 million users have experienced the value of using a Menti!

Building on that product-led foundation, Mentimeter is used daily by more than 84.000 organisations globally across all industries and we now serve more than 3,200 Enterprise customers globally. Our next challenge is to increase a systematic enterprise demand growth engine - and we are looking for a VP Enterprise Marketing to lead that journey.

This is a global leadership role responsible for how Mentimeter creates, identifies and converts enterprise demand. You will lead our Enterprise Marketing organisation, report to our Chief Sales Officer and join Mentimeter's Global Enterprise Leadership Team. Your primary focus will be EMEA and North America, while building the foundations for APAC. The goal is to connect our product adoption, organic reach and customer base into an Enterprise qualified pipeline, ARR and customer growth.

What You'll Lead

You will lead three existing teams, each with an experienced leader, across three connected areas:

Digital demand

Build and optimize enterprise demand generation and capture across web, paid media, account-based programs, content distribution, conversion and nurture.

Field and customer marketing

Develop a global strategy across events, partner programs, customer advocacy, regional activation and use-case storytelling - measured by account engagement, adoption, pipeline and expansion, not simply attendance.

Executive Exchange

Build Mentimeter's Executive Exchange into a distinctive platform for strategic customers, including our Enterprise Community, executive networks, education and certification programs.

What you'll own

Define and own Mentimeter's global Enterprise Marketing strategy, budget and operating model.
Build an integrated system for demand generation and demand capture that turns our PLG footprint and product signals into account-level pipeline.
Set priorities across segments, accounts, audiences, buying groups, use cases and regions, balancing global consistency with local relevance.
Create qualified pipeline and measurable Enterprise ARR impact, with clear accountability for conversion, velocity, attribution and ROI.
Recruit, coach and develop leaders and senior marketing talent, creating an organisation that performs beyond your direct involvement.
Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Growth, Brand, Data and regional leadership to strengthen the handover from product-led growth to sales-assisted opportunities.
Stop, redesign or reallocate investment away from programs that do not create meaningful customer or commercial impact.

What Will Help You Succeed

You are an experienced B2B marketing leader who combines strategic range with commercial discipline. You are likely to bring:

12+ years of B2B SaaS marketing experience, including significant leadership experience in Enterprise Marketing, Demand Generation, Integrated Marketing or a closely related area.
Experience leading leaders and multidisciplinary teams across digital demand, field marketing, customer marketing or executive programs.
A strong understanding of enterprise buying journeys, account-based marketing, buying groups, demand capture and pipeline creation in a PLG environment.
Experience connecting product-led or high-volume inbound growth with a sales-assisted enterprise motion.
Commercial fluency across funnel economics, pipeline, conversion, attribution, investment and ROI.
Experience operating across EMEA and/or North America and adapting global programs to local markets.
An AI-native approach to marketing: using AI to improve insight, experimentation, personalisation and performance - not only individual productivity.

The kind of leader who will thrive here

You create clarity where ownership is shared and the answer is not obvious. You set a high bar while building trust, develop leaders and give talented people meaningful ownership. Most importantly, you want to build - not simply inherit and administer - a modern Enterprise Marketing function, see the strategy through and be accountable for its long-term impact. You are ambitious while staying humble, curious and collaborative in how you get there.

Why this role

You will have the mandate to shape how Mentimeter approaches enterprise demand globally and define the next chapter of our Enterprise growth. If you are looking for a finished playbook, this probably is not the role for you. If you want to build the system and be accountable for its impact, we would like to hear from you.

We're actively hiring for one position, which can be based in either Stockholm or Toronto. The role follows our hybrid way of working.

How we lead at Mentimeter

At Mentimeter, we have a Leadership Manifesto that sets a shared direction for how we lead ourselves, our teams and the business. We call it Heart & Bravery.

It starts with authenticity: knowing yourself, showing yourself and leading yourself.

We expect our leaders to develop high-performing teams through both care and challenge, drive the right results in a changing environment, and set a clear direction by connecting the work to our vision and making the complex simple.

You will learn more about our Leadership Manifesto throughout the recruitment process. These principles are also an important part of how we assess and hire leaders at Mentimeter.

Our recruitment process

We want the process to be transparent and give both you and us the opportunity to get to know each other properly. The steps are:

TA Intro Interview

Hiring Manager Interview:
A 20-minute digital chat with our Chief Sales Officer to meet and learn more about the role
Business Case & Competence Interview

A short business case, submitted the day before the competence interview
Competence interview: 75-minute at our office

Leadership and culture interview:
90-minute at our office
References and a coffee chat
with the team
Offer and signing

Compensation:

At Mentimeter, we believe in fair and transparent compensation that grows with you. The annual base salary range for this role is $226,000–$303,000 CAD. It's intentionally broad to reflect different stages of growth within the role: from growing into its full scope to bringing deep expertise and meaningful impact from day one.

Where an individual is placed within the range depends on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and alignment with the role's requirements. We're committed to supporting your growth. You'll have ongoing development conversations with your manager, and your compensation will be reviewed as your skills, scope and impact evolve.

In addition to your salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package - learn more about it here: https://www.mentimeter.com/benefits/toronto .

What Mentimeter Can Offer

At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues. We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter. Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It's not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.

All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions. Learn more about our benefits by visiting our Benefits & Perks page

AI and Hiring at Mentimeter

At Mentimeter, we believe AI helps us work smarter - but it never replaces the human assessment, curiosity, and personal connection that define our culture and our hiring. We use AI as a sparring partner: to bounce ideas, bring new perspectives, support structure, and make our work more efficient. But the meaning, decisions, and interactions always come from people. AI strengthens our work, but it does not define it. At Mentimeter, we're not building an AI-driven hiring process - we're building a people-first culture, where technology helps us listen, learn, and grow together.

Culture at Mentimeter

At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. A platform where people feel safe, where differences are embraced, a place where you can have fun. We strongly encourage applicants who are people of color, LGBTQ+, women, people with disabilities, and/or formerly incarcerated people, and a college degree is not strictly required. In order to give everyone a voice, we need to be as diverse as our users.

Learn more about our culture by visiting our Culture page.

Review our Privacy Policy for more information.

jobs.description:
The VP of Product and UX at Aha! drives product and business success. You are a proven executive leader who helps shape our product vision, ensures we build lovable experiences, and supports our team and customers to grow revenue.

This Role Is For You If

You have 12+ years of strategic product management experience, including executive leadership
You have deep expertise in product management and UX and a track record of leading successful B2B software product portfolios
You have worked in both startups and larger companies
You have experience building productivity and collaboration enhancing software for business users
You love being actively involved in product discovery, product strategy, and creating what customers will pay for
You thrive leading high-performing teams and developing quality talent
You enjoy partnering with executives to ensure growth and long-term business success
You have a clear point of view and want to help shape the new AI-driven era of product development
You might not watch YouTube Shorts but you know why they are important

Plus, You Want To Join a Company Like This

Pioneers: We established the product management software market and are recognized as market leaders
Different: We are a unique, high-growth software company that is independent of VCs and private equity
Profitable: We put people and profit first. Our company is highly stable and sustainable.
Fully remote: We are experts who achieve our best work where we live — with no drama

Apply now

Our team

Our PM/UX team is a high-achieving group of product leaders, designers, and builders who drive business success. We embrace the Minimum Lovable Product to create products that are valuable and lasting — bringing our customers real joy. We rigorously prioritize our work, design exceptional experiences, and align cross-functional teams around the highest-impact work. And of course, we use our own software to do it.

Our products

Aha! software is built for product teams. Our suite of world-class tools provides everything they need to research, imagine, plan, build, and deliver lovable software. Thousands of the world's most innovative organizations rely on our products to achieve exceptional outcomes.

Advanced AI capabilities are fundamental to our products and how people use them. We help product teams start with strategy and build faster — all while prioritizing what their customers actually need.

We use our own products every day. Doing so helps us develop greater empathy for our users and rapidly increase the value we provide.

You

You are a strategic product executive who enjoys building outstanding software and teams. You balance long-term vision with high-paced execution and know how to make thoughtful trade-offs that create lasting customer value.

You are energized by working directly with customers, collaborating with company leaders, and helping teams achieve their goals. You embrace AI as an essential part of how modern product organizations work and continuously look for ways to improve both the customer experience and internal operations.

Most importantly, you care deeply about building products that customers love and creating an environment where talented people do their best work. Your aim is to be exceptional. And you cannot imagine working any other way. You are looking for sustainable happiness and recognize that this type of role goes well beyond a 9-5 effort.

You Also Have

12+ years of product management experience, with a proven record of executive leadership in B2B SaaS
8+ years of experience leading dynamic product organizations
Success defining and executing product strategy that drives revenue, retention, and business growth
Experience leading high-performing product managers and UX designers
Driven product-led success that was based on free trial acquisition models
A history of partnering closely with engineering, customer success, and marketing to deliver companywide outcomes
Experience building trusted relationships with executive customers and using their insights to influence product strategy
Clear written and verbal communication skills
A thoughtful perspective on the impact of AI and how it is transforming product development

Grow with us

We offer comprehensive benefits — including profit sharing — and aim to provide equivalent coverage for international teammates.

Retirement contributions: Percentage of total pay, contributed monthly
Medical, dental, and vision: Many teammates are covered at 100%
Paid time off: Up to 200 hours off per year
Parental leave: 30 to 90 days, plus paid care/bereavement leave
Learning stipend: Up to $1,000 annually, plus paid learning time

Base salary and total compensation are dependent upon many factors, including skills, experience, and relevant past roles.

Join us

If you are ready for a career-defining opportunity, we would love to hear from you. Every application is reviewed by a real person.

It is important to us to have authentic conversations with candidates. This helps us understand and value each candidate's skills, experiences, and ambition. For these reasons, we do not allow candidates to use AI tools during interviews without our prior approval.

About Aha!

Aha! is the world's #1 product management software. We help more than 1 million product builders bring their strategy to life. Our integrated tools empower teams to go from discovery to delivery. The suite includes Aha! Roadmaps, Aha! Discovery, Aha! Ideas, Aha! Whiteboards, Aha! Builder, Aha! Develop, Aha! Teamwork, and Aha! Knowledge. Product teams rely on our expertise, AI assistant, and training programs via Aha! Academy to do their best work. We are proud to be a very different type of high-growth SaaS company. The business is self-funded, profitable, and 100% remote. We are recognized as one of the best fully remote companies to work for, champion the Bootstrap Movement, and have given over $1.5M to people in need through Aha! Cares. Learn more at www.aha.io.

jobs.description:
We are committed to connecting Canadians through unique partnerships, our world-class network and content Canadians love—and our innovative team is growing. We are looking for dedicated team members to join our Corporate team who have a genuine passion for making positive impacts on customers and the communities where we live and work. We have a variety of business units with exciting and meaningful work waiting for you, including Communications, HR, Legal and Corporate Affairs, Supply Chain, Finance, and Real Estate. If you are considering your next step, we have exciting opportunities waiting for you. Come build a rewarding career at Rogers and be a driving force behind our success story!

Who We Are Looking For

The Senior Director, Marketing, is the portfolio marketing leader for Rogers Sports & Media, responsible for building audiences, accelerating subscription growth and strengthening the market leadership of our consumer brands. This role sets the integrated brand and go-to-market agenda across the full Sportsnet portfolio, television and specialty brands, streaming products and services, and Rogers’ national radio network of 40+ stations.

Leading a team of 15+ marketers, the Senior Director translates audience insight, content priorities and business goals into distinctive brand platforms, full-funnel marketing plans, partner programs and high-impact advertising. The role works across a complex matrix of content, product, distribution, revenue, media, insights, creative and agency partners to deliver measurable growth and consistent brand experiences across every audience touchpoint.

What You'll Do

Sports The full Sportsnet portfolio, including linear channels, digital platforms, audio, social, direct-to-consumer products and priority league, team and event properties.
Television and specialty Entertainment brands and services across broadcast, specialty, digital and on-demand environments.
Streaming Owned DTC products and partner-distributed OTT offerings across web, apps, connected television and third-party platforms.
Radio Portfolio marketing support for Rogers’ network of 40+ stations, strengthening local relevance while leveraging national scale
Grow audiences across platforms Increase reach, consideration, tune-in, engagement and frequency across linear, digital, audio, social and streaming platforms by connecting priority content with clearly defined audience and fan segments.
Accelerate DTC and OTT subscription growth Build integrated acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention and win-back programs that grow paid subscriptions, improve customer lifetime value and reduce churn across owned services and third-party partner networks.
Maximize partner-distributed growth Develop scalable joint marketing, merchandising and promotional programs with BDU, connected-TV, device and streaming partners to expand discovery, conversion and usage.
Protect and extend market leadership Maintain strong leadership positions for Rogers Sports & Media brands in every market in which they operate through differentiated positioning, consistent brand stewardship, local relevance and disciplined competitive response.
Improve marketing effectiveness Establish clear portfolio KPIs, measurement frameworks and optimization routines that connect marketing investment to audience, subscriber, revenue and brand outcomes.
Build one high-performing portfolio team Create a clear operating model, shared standards and an inclusive performance culture that strengthens capabilities, develops talent and improves speed, quality and accountability.
Portfolio Strategy and Brand Leadership Set the multi-year portfolio marketing strategy and annual integrated marketing roadmap, aligning audience, subscriber, revenue and brand objectives across Sportsnet, television, streaming and radio.
Define and steward brand promises, positioning, architectures, identities and customer experiences, ensuring each brand is distinctive while contributing to the strength of Rogers Sports & Media and Rogers.
Translate consumer, fan, cultural and market insight into prioritized growth opportunities, audience segments and go-to-market plans.
Guide brand and product alignment across content, platforms and distribution models, ensuring a consistent experience from awareness through consumption and loyalty.
Act as a senior marketing advisor to business and content leaders, bringing a portfolio view to investment choices, market opportunities and competitive challenges.
Audience and Subscriber Growth Lead always-on and tentpole marketing strategies that grow audiences for priority sports, shows, personalities, stations, franchises and platforms.
Own the marketing strategy across the customer lifecycle, including awareness, consideration, acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, churn reduction and reactivation.
Partner with product, analytics and revenue teams to improve conversion, engagement, retention and lifetime value across DTC and OTT products.
Develop channel and platform merchandising strategies that improve content discovery and consumption across owned and partner environments.
Build joint business and marketing plans with distribution partners, including BDUs, OTT aggregators, connected-TV platforms, device ecosystems and other strategic partners.
Cultivate league, team, talent, content and commercial partnerships that expand reach, deepen fan engagement and create differentiated audience experiences.
Integrated Marketing, Advertising and Creative Excellence
Lead development of full-funnel marketing plans and advertising calendars across paid, owned, earned, social, experiential, partnership, CRM and on-platform channels.
Set clear strategic briefs and creative standards that inspire distinctive, effective work and support consistent brand delivery across the portfolio.
Oversee campaign development from insight and briefing through media, production, launch, optimization and post-campaign evaluation.
Balance national portfolio priorities with the local market needs of radio stations and regional brands.
Partner closely with internal creative, media agency partners, communications and production teams, as well as external vendors and partners, to deliver work efficiently and at a high standard.
Identify emerging platforms, technologies and marketing approaches that can improve audience experience, marketing effectiveness and speed to market.
Own portfolio marketing budgets and resource planning, directing investment toward the highest-value audience, subscriber and brand opportunities.
Establish annual objectives, benchmarks, scorecards and tactical targets across brand health, audience, subscription, engagement, retention and campaign performance.
Create a disciplined test-and-learn approach, using audience, product and campaign data to optimize investment and improve future planning.
Streamline briefs, governance, approvals and campaign workflows to increase clarity, accountability, speed and operational efficiency.
Build common marketing practices, tools and planning frameworks that can be leveraged across brands, products and business units.
Maintain strong agency, vendor and platform relationships while ensuring appropriate commercial discipline, quality and performance.
Lead, coach and develop a diverse team of 15+ marketing professionals, setting clear priorities, decision rights and performance expectations.
Build succession strength and provide meaningful development opportunities that expand strategic, digital, commercial and leadership capabilities.
Create an environment of collaboration, curiosity, inclusion, accountability and high performance.
Influence across senior and cross-functional teams, aligning content, product, distribution, sales, revenue, insights, media and creative partners around shared outcomes.
Champion customer- and audience-first thinking throughout Rogers Sports & Media.

Measures of Success

Audience growth across priority linear, streaming, digital, audio and social platforms.
Net DTC and partner-distributed subscription growth, supported by stronger acquisition efficiency, engagement and retention.
Improved content discovery, tune-in, usage and frequency across owned and partner platforms.
Sustained or improved market leadership and brand health across sports, television, streaming and radio brands.
Clear contribution of marketing to revenue, customer lifetime value and portfolio growth.
Higher marketing effectiveness through stronger measurement, optimized media investment and more efficient operating practices.
A high-performing, engaged team with strong talent development, succession depth and cross-functional reputation.

Experience And Qualifications

Progressive senior marketing leadership experience (15+ years) in media, entertainment, sports, streaming, subscription, technology or another complex consumer business.
Demonstrated success leading a multi-brand or multi-product portfolio and translating business strategy into integrated marketing action.
Strong understanding of the Canadian media environment, audience behaviour, sports fandom, broadcast marketing and the evolving streaming ecosystem.
Proven experience driving audience growth and subscription outcomes across DTC and partner-distributed channels.
Expertise in brand strategy, portfolio management, audience segmentation, full-funnel marketing, performance media, CRM and lifecycle marketing.
Demonstrated ability to use brand, product, audience and campaign analytics to make investment decisions and optimize performance.
Experience leading sizable teams and developing next-generation marketing talent.
Ability to lead through influence in a matrixed organization and build trusted relationships with senior executives, content leaders, product teams, partners and agencies.
Strong commercial acumen, including budget ownership, vendor management, prioritization and resource allocation.
Exceptional strategic thinking, communication and executive presentation skills, paired with a bias for action and executional excellence.

Leadership Profile

Audience-obsessed Deeply curious about what makes Canadians watch, listen, subscribe, engage and return.
Enterprise-minded Sees connections across brands and platforms and makes choices for the strength of the total portfolio.
Growth-oriented Combines brand-building ambition with performance discipline and commercial accountability.
Creatively ambitious Raises the quality and distinctiveness of the work while remaining focused on measurable outcomes.
Data-led Uses evidence to sharpen strategy, accelerate learning and improve decisions without losing human insight.
Collaborative and influential Brings diverse partners together, creates clarity and moves complex work forward.
People-first Sets a high bar, coaches with intention and creates opportunities for others to grow.

Key Relationships

Internal

Rogers Sports & Media senior leadership; Sportsnet, Television/Streaming and Radio business and content leaders; Brand, Creative, Media, Communications, Product, Technology, Distribution, Revenue, Sales, Insights, Analytics, Finance and People teams.

External

Media agencies; league, team, talent and content partners; BDU and OTT platform partners; production and technology vendors; and strategic commercial partners.

What’s in It for You?

We believe in investing in our people and helping them reach their potential as valuable members of our team. As part of our team, you’ll have access to a wide range of incredible resources, growth opportunities, discounts and perks, including

Competitive salary and annual bonus.
Competitive and flexible health and dental benefits, pension plan, RRSP, TFSA and stock matching programs.
Discounts Enjoy up to 50% off Rogers services and Blue Jays tickets, 25% off TSC items, and a 20% discount on all wireless accessories sold in Rogers stores.
Paid time off for volunteering.
Company matching contributions to charities you support.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Technical Development Lead, Device
jobs.description:
BlueRock Therapeutics, a wholly-owned and independently operated subsidiary of Bayer AG, is a leading engineered cell therapy company pioneering a new generation of cellular medicines. Utilizing our proprietary CELL+GENE™ platform, we direct cellular differentiation and genetically engineer cells to create transformative therapies for patients suffering from neurological and ophthalmological diseases.

Founded in 2016, BlueRock is at the forefront of the convergence of cell biology and genetic engineering. Our mission is to harness pluripotent stem cell technology and gene editing to deliver authentic, functional cell therapies that address the root causes of disease and offer hope to millions of patients worldwide.

What Are We Doing?

Our foundational science enables the generation and directed differentiation of universal pluripotent stem cells into authentic, functional cells for allogeneic cellular therapies.

We are passionate about realizing the promise of cell and gene therapy, shaping the future of regenerative medicine, and delivering new therapies to patients with limited or no treatment options.

Who is BlueRock?

BlueRock Therapeutics LP is a clinical stage cell therapy company harnessing the power of cell therapy to create a pipeline of new medicines for people suffering from neurological and ophthalmic diseases. Two of our novel investigational cell therapies, bemdaneprocel (BRT-DA01) for the treatment of Parkinson’s disease and OpCT-001 for the treatment of primary photoreceptor diseases are clinical stage programs. BlueRock was founded in 2016 as a joint venture of Versant Ventures and Leaps by Bayer. Our culture is defined by the courage to persist regardless of the challenge, the urgency to transform medicine and deliver hope, integrity guided by mission, and community-mindedness with the understanding that we are all part of something bigger than ourselves.

What Are We Doing?

Our foundational science harnesses the ability to create and then direct the differentiation of universal pluripotent stem cells into authentic, functional cells that can be used as allogeneic cellular therapies to treat a broad array of diseases. We can also further engineer these cells, enabling them to produce enzymes, antibodies, and other proteins for additional therapeutic benefit.

We are passionate about delivering on the promise of cellular and gene therapy, shaping the future of cellular medicine, and delivering new therapies to millions of patients with treatment options.

We are seeking individuals who are collaborative, thrive in a fun and dynamic culture, and are steadfast in the commitment to advance cutting-edge cellular therapies to impact patients’ lives.

Description Of Position

40 million users have experienced the value of using a Menti!

Digital demand

What you'll own

Set priorities across segments, accounts, audiences, buying groups, use cases and regions, balancing global consistency with local relevance.

Recruit, coach and develop leaders and senior marketing talent, creating an organisation that performs beyond your direct involvement.

Stop, redesign or reallocate investment away from programs that do not create meaningful customer or commercial impact.

What Will Help You Succeed

12+ years of B2B SaaS marketing experience, including significant leadership experience in Enterprise Marketing, Demand Generation, Integrated Marketing or a closely related area.
Experience leading leaders and multidisciplinary teams across digital demand, field marketing, customer marketing or executive programs.
A strong understanding of enterprise buying journeys, account-based marketing, buying groups, demand capture and pipeline creation in a PLG environment.
Experience connecting product-led or high-volume inbound growth with a sales-assisted enterprise motion.
Commercial fluency across funnel economics, pipeline, conversion, attribution, investment and ROI.
Experience operating across EMEA and/or North America and adapting global programs to local markets.
An AI-native approach to marketing: using AI to improve insight, experimentation, personalisation and performance - not only individual productivity.

The kind of leader who will thrive here

You create clarity where ownership is shared and the answer is not obvious. You set a high bar while building trust, develop leaders and give talented people meaningful ownership. You are ambitious while staying humble, curious and collaborative in how you get there.

Why this role

You will have the mandate to shape how Mentimeter approaches enterprise demand globally and define the next chapter of our Enterprise growth. If you are looking for a finished playbook, this probably is not the role for you. If you want to build the system and be accountable for its impact, we would like to hear from you.

How we lead at Mentimeter

At Mentimeter, we have a Leadership Manifesto that sets a shared direction for how we lead ourselves, our teams and the business. We call it Heart & Bravery.

It starts with authenticity: knowing yourself, showing yourself and leading yourself.

We expect our leaders to develop high-performing teams through both care and challenge, drive the right results in a changing environment, and set a clear direction by connecting the work to our vision and making the complex simple.

Our recruitment process

TA Intro Interview

Hiring Manager Interview:
A 20-minute digital chat with our Chief Sales Officer to meet and learn more about the role

90-minute at our office

with the team

At Mentimeter, we believe AI helps us work smarter - but it never replaces the human assessment, curiosity, and personal connection that define our culture and our hiring. At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. Head of Retention & Customer Experience

Own customer retention, reduce churn, and maximise customer lifetime value across two growing DTC pet brands.

Job Overview
We’re looking for an experienced Head of Retention & Customer Experience
to lead the retention strategy and customer experience function for a profitable, fast-growing direct-to-consumer pet brand.
You’ll take full ownership of everything that happens after a customer's first purchase, including subscription management, email and SMS marketing, post-purchase journeys, customer experience, and retention analytics.
Reporting directly to the founder, you’ll lead a Customer Experience Manager and oversee an external retention agency. Your focus will be improving customer lifetime value (LTV), reducing churn, increasing repeat purchases, and building a scalable retention function across two brands.
This is a fully remote, full-time independent contractor position for candidates based outside the United States.

Annual Base Compensation:
US$115,000–US$145,000
Performance Bonus:
15–20% of base salary after the trial period.
About the Company
Our client is a profitable DTC pet brand generating more than US$50 million in annual revenue
through Shopify, Amazon, and Chewy.
The business has built its growth on strong paid acquisition and product performance. A second brand has recently launched, creating an opportunity to expand into a new customer base.
Retention has previously been managed by a lean internal team supported by an external email and SMS agency. This role will establish one senior owner responsible for the entire post-purchase customer journey and retention performance across both brands.
The company is focused on scaling from US$50 million or more toward nine-figure annual revenue.

Key Responsibilities
1. Own the Subscription Programme
Manage the subscription programme through Loop across both brands.
Develop and optimise subscription offers, billing cadence, bundles, and customer portal experiences.
Improve subscription retention, save rates, and customer lifetime value.
Build and optimise cancellation prevention, save, and win-back flows.
Identify opportunities to reduce subscription churn and increase recurring revenue.

2. Lead Email and SMS Retention Strategy
Set the overall email and SMS marketing strategy.
Direct the retention agency's campaign calendar, automated flows, targets, and results.
Ensure agency activities align with retention and revenue objectives.
Review campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve engagement, repeat purchases, and customer value.
Hold the agency accountable for measurable results rather than campaign execution alone.

3. Own the Post-Purchase Customer Journey
Oversee the customer experience from the first purchase through repeat purchases and long-term loyalty.
Identify opportunities to improve the post-purchase journey.
Evaluate and implement loyalty, referral, and VIP programmes where supported by the numbers.
Develop initiatives that strengthen customer relationships and encourage repeat purchases.
Ensure retention initiatives support both customer satisfaction and business profitability.

4. Lead Customer Experience Operations
Manage and develop the Customer Experience Manager.
Establish customer service policies covering refunds, replacements, and exceptions.
Ensure customer experience decisions balance customer satisfaction with business margins.
Provide clear guidelines for handling customer concerns and escalations.
Improve service consistency and operational efficiency across both brands.

5. Build Retention Analytics and Reporting
Develop a reliable retention data and reporting structure.
Track key performance indicators, including:
Cohort retention.
Repeat purchase rate.
Customer lifetime value (LTV) by brand and acquisition channel.
Subscription churn and save rates.
Build weekly retention scorecards to monitor performance.
Use customer and cohort data to identify the biggest opportunities for improvement.
Translate findings into clear priorities and measurable action plans.

6. Lead Retention Reviews and Build Processes
Conduct monthly retention performance reviews with the CEO.
Present results, key trends, challenges, and recommended actions.
Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) for retention and customer experience operations.
Document strategies, workflows, policies, and performance expectations.
Build a scalable retention function that supports the growth of both brands.

Required Experience & Qualifications
Senior-level experience in DTC retention, lifecycle marketing, or CRM.
Proven experience independently owning a retention function.
Hands-on experience managing subscription programmes and improving churn, save rates, and customer lifetime value.
Experience directing an external email and SMS agency, including strategy, targets, performance reviews, and results.
Strong understanding of post-purchase customer journeys, repeat purchase behaviour, and customer retention.
Experience managing customer experience teams or leading a Customer Experience Manager.
Ability to establish customer service policies covering refunds, replacements, and exceptions while protecting business margins.
Strong analytical skills and experience using cohort data to identify retention opportunities.
Ability to translate performance insights into clear strategies and measurable actions.
Strong leadership, communication, decision-making, and process development skills.
Must be based outside the United States
and available to work full-time contractor hours.

Compensation & Engagement
Annual Base Compensation:
US$115,000–US$145,000, depending on experience.
Performance Bonus:
15–20% of base compensation after the trial period.
Engagement:
Full-time independent contractor.
Payment:
Monthly invoicing.
Location:
Fully remote; candidates must be based outside the US.
Working Hours:
Full-time hours with flexibility.
Reporting Line:
Directly to the founder.

What You Can Expect
Direct reporting to the founder with no unnecessary management layers.
Full ownership of retention performance across two established DTC brands.
Leadership responsibility for a Customer Experience Manager and external retention agency.
The opportunity to shape subscription, CRM, lifecycle marketing, and customer experience strategy.
A lean, senior-level team with a focus on measurable business outcomes.
Significant autonomy and flexibility in a fully remote contractor role.
The opportunity to help scale a profitable US$50M+ business toward nine-figure annual revenue.

If you have successfully led DTC retention functions, managed subscription programmes, improved customer lifetime value, and built effective customer experience operations, we’d like to hear from you.
